profile.headline: Software Engineer at IBM
profile.summary:
I am a new grad software engineer who is passionate about learning new technologies in order to produce innovative solutions and seamless user experiences. At the core, I simply enjoy solving challenging, real-world problems leveraging my technical skillset. 

Please feel free to reach out to me at kobemhlee@gmail.com.

positions.title: Backend Developer
positions.description:
• Focused on developing reliable means of transferring geofencing coordinates, current locations of vehicles, video feed, and current vehicle health through Python and Django Rest API
• Contributed to the Ground Control Station team within backend, primarily focused on implementing data communication through Python libraries and JSON-based data storage

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed PERL scripts and SQL queries to automate and build data reports for customers
• Implemented problem report fixes and enhancement reports for customer relationship management software utilizing Java and JavaScript
• Interfaced with 100+ users in order to produce over timely solutions to software issues
• Employed agile development principles through daily stand-up meetings and Jira Sprint board

positions.title: Programming and Robotics Teacher
positions.description:
• Individually instructed weekly coding classes on Python and HTML programming languages to classes of 15-20 students from Los Angeles and Walnut Valley Unified School Districts
• Motivated young students to pursue STEM education through exploration of comprehensive solutions

positions.title: Programming Instructor
positions.description:
• Instructed daily coding classes on Python and Scratch to classes of up to 30 students from surrounding Los Angeles and Torrance School Districts
• Encouraged students to explore topics that are not traditionally offered in the K12 Curriculum
• Assisted with writing Scratch and HTML based curriculum course material

positions.title: Math Tutor
positions.description:
• Tutored math from elementary arithmetic to high school Calculus
• Facilitated educational interactions with over thirty students regularly

certifications.name: IBM Watson and Cloud Foundations Badge
certifications.title: IBM Watson and Cloud Foundations Badge

projects.title: Street Smart Web Service
projects.description:
• Developed a web service based in Vue.js and Java Spring as a senior project under the Software Engineering course 
• Personally responsible for MongoDB back-end integration, Axios HTTP Client Requests, and regular AWS EC2 deployments
• Worked with front-end website UI and conducted thorough testing of database functionality

projects.title: Thought Bubble
projects.description:
• Web service utilizing C language to provide simple note-taking platform on terminal-based interface
• Utilized multi-threading and concurrency to handle various service clients
